summary: Refresh only affected roster cards after common claims and work-lease expiry

replay.detail: Only disposable roster projection caches change. Existing graph replay and recovery behavior are unchanged.

schema.detail: No table, index, stored row format, or schema-version changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests, or coordinated member upgrade requirements change.

compatibility.detail: Roster card responses retain their existing fields, membership, history, selected-coverage and local-observation fences. Common agent and work claims refresh the cards that read them. Queue-affecting changes and lease deadlines refresh queue selection and labels once and refold only cards whose queue fields change. Unknown and unclassified structural claims still require a cold projection.

downtime.detail: No migration or additional upgrade downtime is introduced beyond the ordinary process restart.

manual.detail: No new installation, configuration, or state conversion steps are required.

recovery.detail: Roster caches are disposable and rebuild after restart. An older binary can read the unchanged graph and projections without rollback conversion.
